audit.whatIsWrong: 'Chip him between fury windows' ignores how his fury is generated.
audit.why: Reign of Anger generates MORE fury the lower his life is, so trickle poke actively refills the resource that powers the combo which kills you. His empty-fury window shrinks as he drops.
audit.corrected: Poking him low speeds up his fury regeneration — trade to deny CS and take plates, not to grind his bar down.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 1-6 spikes never give Ruthless Predator's or Dominus' cooldowns.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8s and Slice and Dice 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at rank 1 — both are sixteen seconds early, which is a long free window most players never claim. Dominus is 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: At rank 1 his stun and his dash are both 16s — after he spends either, you own the wave until it returns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields — the single worst interaction for Akshan — is absent.
audit.why: Above 50 Fury his W slashes three times, DESTROYS damage shields on the target, and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Akshan's whole trade pattern banks on Dirty Fighting's third-hit shield, and a fury W deletes it outright while doubling the stun. Empowered Slice and Dice also reduces your armour.
audit.corrected: A fury-empowered Ruthless Predator destroys your Dirty Fighting shield and stuns for 1.5s — never trade into a full fury bar expecting the shield to hold.

edits.before: Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) is his cleanest kill window — once he has fury he can E in, W-stun, and fury-Q heal-chunk you before your E (Heroic Swing) can swing you to safety.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator (16s at rank 1) is his cleanest kill window — with fury it stuns 1.5s AND destroys your Dirty Fighting shield, so the trade you planned around simply doesn't happen.

edits.before: Dominus gives Renekton bonus HP plus AoE fury generation, fueling repeated W-stun all-ins — and being stunned interrupts your R (Comeuppance) channel, so you can't finish him through it.
edits.after: Dominus (120s at rank 1) gives bonus HP plus AoE fury generation, fueling repeated shield-shattering W all-ins — and being stunned interrupts your R channel, so you can't finish him through it.

edits.before: E in, land W (Ruthless Predator) stun, and dump a fury-empowered Q+autos before your E can swing you out
edits.after: E in, land a fury Ruthless Predator to shatter your shield and stun 1.5s, then dump Q and autos

edits.before: His W stun comes online and, once he's dashed into range, locks you into a fury-Q combo before your E exists — concede the trade.
edits.after: His W comes online and, with fury, it destroys your passive shield and stuns 1.5s before your E exists — concede the trade outright.

edits.before: Your Q and passive second-shot chip him between fury windows, but his combo still kills you if you get caught — genuinely even.
edits.after: Your Q and second-shot chip him, but poking him low only feeds Reign of Anger faster, and a fury combo still kills you — genuinely even.

edits.before: Renekton owns these levels and you have to respect it. Once he has fury he can E in, W-stun you (Ruthless Predator is his lock, not point-and-click — he has to reach you with the dash), and fury-Q to heal off the trade while he chunks you, all before your E can swing you out. Don't contest autos at level 1-2; last-hit at the tip of your Q (Avengerang) and only fire your passive second-shot when his fury bar is empty and his E dash is on cooldown. When his fury's gone he's a melee with no stun and no gap-closer — that's your only safe window to throw Q.
edits.after: Renekton owns these levels and you have to respect it. Once he has fury he can E in, W-stun you (Ruthless Predator is his lock, and he has to reach you with the dash), and fury-Q to heal off the trade — and above 50 Fury that W destroys your Dirty Fighting shield and stuns for a full 1.5s. Don't contest autos at level 1-2; last-hit at the tip of your Avengerang. Both his stun and his dash are 16s at rank 1, so the moment he spends either you own the wave. Remember his fury builds FASTER the lower he is, so chip to deny CS, not to grind the bar.

edits.before: This is where it levels out. With E (Heroic Swing) you finally have an answer to his all-in — save it to swing OUT of his W stun-lock instead of burning it for poke, because if you eat the stun with no escape his fury-Q combo just kills you. Keep chipping with Q and your passive second-shot between his fury windows; he can't out-sustain that. At 6 his Dominus all-in is real and being stunned interrupts your R (Comeuppance) channel, so don't start the ult into a fresh W — bait the stun first, then fire R once you're free.
edits.after: This is where it levels out. With Heroic Swing you finally have an answer to his all-in — save it to swing OUT of the stun-lock instead of burning it for poke, because a fury Ruthless Predator shatters your shield and holds you 1.5s, long enough for the Q combo to kill. Keep chipping between his fury windows, but never assume the shield will hold. At 6 Dominus is real and being stunned interrupts your Comeuppance channel, so don't start the ult into a fresh W — bait the stun first, then fire once you're free.

notes: The empowered W shield-destroy is the decisive interaction in this lane and appeared nowhere: Akshan's entire trade pattern is built on Dirty Fighting's shield, and above 50 Fury Renekton removes it while doubling the stun duration.
